prompt.content: What was the maximum elevation of the QF 4-inch Mk V guns on HMS Grasshopper (T85)?

output:
The maximum elevation of the QF 4-inch Mk V gun on HMS **Grasshopper (T-class, T-85)** was **40 degrees**.
